reviews.comment: Even for a prof, Montez is really talented. He relates course material at a deep level, building from the basics to more complicated concepts. Very focused on learning rather than busywork. Though he doesn't have required homework, I highly recommend working on extra problems outside of class.

I received a grade of C in the class, however that has nothing to do with the prof. He is a fantastic prof and you should absolutely take him if you ever see him available. His lectures are good but his lecture notes are incredible and provide all the information you need to do well in this class. You should do extra problems to do well on exams.

His lectures and notes are very clear and well done, with lots of example problems. He's good at answering questions in class and will upload further explanation later if needed. No homework, a few group projects and quizzes, and two exams that he is pretty generous with partial credit on. 363 is a harder class but I think Montez is the way to go.
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Graded by few things
